issue.title: UModal throws "Cannot read properties of undefined" when closed with Escape
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

Since upgrading, pressing Escape while a `UModal` is open closes it but throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'focus')` in the console, and the page stops responding to keyboard shortcuts until I reload. Clicking the close button works fine. It happens on every modal in our app.

### Expected behavior

Escape closes the modal without an error.
